name: agrolia
description: Современная WordPress тема для агрономической компании
author: Agrolia Team

scripts.watch: node-sass css/style.css -o css/ --source-map true --output-style expanded --indent-type tab --indent-width 1 -w
scripts.build: npm run compile:css && npm run compile:rtl && npm run minify
scripts.bundle: dir-archiver --src . --dest ../agrolia.zip --exclude .DS_Store .stylelintrc.json .eslintrc .git .gitattributes .github .gitignore README.md composer.json composer.lock node_modules vendor package-lock.json package.json .travis.yml phpcs.xml.dist css/style.css.map yarn.lock
